titulo: AI demand will push up interest rates around the world, IMF head warns
cuerpo: Kristalina Georgieva says countries needed to be ready for tech rollout, adding: ‘You snooze, you lose’ Business live – latest updates Booming demand for artificial intelligence will force the world’s most powerful central banks to raise interest rates, the head of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned. Kristalina Georgieva, the managing director of the Washington-based fund, said demand for AI hardware and related technology products was pushing up consumer prices around the world.
